gloss: to open one's mouth; to open (a container)

definitions.gloss: to open one's mouth (to speak, yawn, or receive food, medicine, or a dental exam)
definitions.explanation: The basic, literal sense: to physically open the mouth. Commonly heard at the dentist ({口|くち}を{大|おお}きく{開|あ}けてください), when feeding a baby or an animal, or when describing someone yawning or singing. Note: for the sense 'to start talking; to speak up', Japanese usually prefers {口|くち}を{開|ひら}く with the reading ひらく.

definitions.gloss: to open (a bottle, package, or other container); to unseal
definitions.explanation: By extension from the 'mouth' metaphor for openings: to remove the cap or seal of a bottle, jar, bag, or similar container, often for the first time. Common with foods, drinks, cosmetics, and medicines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦あくびをした→あくびをする：25803_akubiwosuru⟧。
examples.english: The baby opened its mouth and yawned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧であご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げた→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: When the dentist said 'Please open your mouth a little wider,' I spread my jaws open for all I was worth.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける。
examples.english: To open a bottle of wine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the new bottle of soy sauce, the aroma wafted up.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ジャム→ジャム：01779_jamu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瓶|びん}→瓶：01016_bin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the jar of jam that I had received as a souvenir, a sweet aroma filled the entire room.

notes:
The construction is noun ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + verb ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧. ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ here refers literally to the mouth (sense 1) or to the opening/mouth of a container (sense 2); ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ is the transitive verb 'to open'.

USAGE:
- Sense 1 is nearly always concrete and physical. The metaphorical 'open one's mouth = start speaking' sense is normally carried by ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (same kanji, but read ひらく). Beginning learners often conflate them.
- For the intransitive counterpart (a mouth/container opens by itself or is open), use ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧ or the state form ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧.
- In sense 2, ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ is a near-synonym, especially for unsealing a new package or bottle for the very first time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open one's mouth wide
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to open one's mouth and laugh
- ⟦あくびをして→あくびをする：25803_akubiwosuru⟧{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける: to open one's mouth in a yawn
- ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける: to open a bottle of wine
- ⟦{瓶|びん}→瓶：01016_bin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける: to open the mouth of a bottle
- ⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口|くち}を{開|あ}ける: to open the mouth of a bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open one's mouth (and speak); to break one's silence — figurative use, focused on speech.
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to be the first to speak; also to unseal a new container — overlaps with sense 2 when referring to opening something for the first time.
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧ / ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close one's mouth — the antonym.
- ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open — the general transitive verb; combines freely with many objects (door, window, box).
